About.title: About Us
About.description: Our story, our values, and our commitment to bringing you the finest honey.
About.storyP1: Organic Store was born from a simple belief: everyone deserves access to pure, honest honey. We partner directly with local beekeepers across Saudi Arabia, ensuring fair trade and the highest quality standards.
About.storyP2: Every jar is traceable to its source apiary. We never blend, heat, or process our honey — preserving the natural enzymes, flavors, and health benefits that make raw honey so special.
About.value1Text: No additives, no shortcuts — just pure honey as nature intended.
About.value2Text: We pay beekeepers fairly and support sustainable beekeeping practices.
About.value3Text: Protecting bee populations and their natural habitats is at our core.
About.value4Text: Full traceability from hive to jar — know exactly where your honey comes from.
About.step1Text: Beekeepers harvest honey at peak season when flavor and nutrients are richest.
About.step2Text: Each batch is lab-tested for purity, then gently packed without heating.
About.step3Text: Fresh honey arrives at your door within 48 hours of packing.
